title: CopenScene
problem: Concerts for Copenhagen's metal, hardcore and punk scene are spread over 28 venue websites.
people: Fans of the scene who want one overview, and to hear when a show changes.
build: A scheduled worker scrapes the 28 venues on a curated list into Postgres. It re-reads only concerts whose listing changed, so a daily run takes seconds.
A React client lists the concerts and shows them on a map.
Fans mark concerts with a passwordless account and get an email when a marked concert changes status.
Decisions are written down as architecture decision records (ADRs).

title: fstack
problem: A Claude Code setup of plugins, skills, an output style and instructions lives as loose files in ~/.claude, and every machine needs the same copy.
people: Daily Claude Code users with more than one machine.
build: One git repository holds the whole setup, and one install script links and installs every part.
The repository is also a Claude Code plugin marketplace, so each plugin installs on its own from GitHub.
It holds six plugins, four skills and one output style.
The spec-checks plugin checks OpenSpec specs and changes with a CLI that also runs in CI. Its suite has 204 tests.

title: sieve
problem: Job boards list many postings, and checking each one against a CV by hand takes time.
people: Anyone following several job boards, with their own CV to rank the postings against.
build: Fetches postings from five public job boards on a schedule and removes duplicates of one job across boards.
A language model extracts the facts of each posting and judges how well it fits the CV.
Code applies the hard constraints, such as location and spoken language, and computes the score from the user's weights.
Runs for a single user, as one Node.js process with one SQLite file. Nine OpenSpec specs hold 181 scenarios, each mapped to a unit test.

title: Agent-first CLIs
problem: AI agents that call an API directly can misread its output and act without a person's approval.
people: AI agents, and the people who supervise what those agents do.
build: Standard output carries JSON data only. Errors go to standard error as structured JSON.
Typed exit codes separate auth, validation, not found, network and schema drift.
brevo-cli reaches all 291 Brevo API operations and refuses outward actions, such as sending email, until a person approves.
A family of CLIs: Hevy, Brevo, Scryfall, Archidekt, Hardcover, Yazio and Saxo.
